mentions.name: MicroStore
mentions.description: A FOSS command-line tool that builds a static web page for a small brick-and-mortar store. The generated site displays sales and the types of items the store offers, and is meant to be linked from a QR code on a banner outside the store to increase foot traffic.
mentions.problem: Small stores with heavy foot traffic are underserved by big tech web offerings and lack an easy way to advertise sales and inventory online.
mentions.audience: Small brick-and-mortar stores with lots of foot traffic that are underserved by big tech offerings
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on a CLI tool that will build a static web page for a small brick and mortar store. The software is FOSS and could be useful for the small store that has a lot of foot traffic, but is under served by many of the big tech offerings. The idea is that foot traffic can be increased by using a QR code placed on a banner outside the store directing them to the website that can display sales and types of items that the store offers.
